notes: False for unitriangular J: k = 1 (A132870) has T(30,0) = R/2, R odd (also k = 3 at (30,0); k = 2 integral to row 36). Lean main theorem A132870_row30_not_integral: rows 0..29 integer satisfy the row equations, row R/2 completes row 30, R(0) odd. Outside Lean: uniqueness of the rational solution (coefficient of J(n,j) in (J^(kn))(n,j) is kn). Reading: diagonal 1 (as in both entries); with J(0,0) free the question is not settled.
